answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. By the tide of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the quartz of a task receipt, and the walnut is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
